source: Starting point, not official. Black Album rig: Mesa Mark IIC+ / Simul-Class Mark II (Guitar World 1991 via Ground Guitar) blended with a Jose-modded Marshall, 9-11 cabs, Aphex EQ in the loop, a 1.2 kHz cut for tight rhythm (Guitar Chalk). Amp averages tonemirror (7/6/5/6/6), rigtone (7/3/3/9/4), Guitar Chalk (7/6/3/6/5) as gain/bass/mid/treble/presence. BG MARK3 is the closest Mesa; the Marshall blend cannot be built in one chain. GEQ cut around 1.2 kHz and the small room are estimates.
